title: Income Annuities Issue Limits Schedule: Ages, Purchase Amounts and Purchase Sources
content:
Issue ages are the annuitant's age last birthday on the issue date; on the joint tiers the highest issue age applies to the older annuitant and the joint minimum age to the younger. Purchase amounts are in US dollars.

## Ages and amounts by tier

| Tier | Lowest issue age | Highest issue age | Lowest age of younger joint annuitant | Smallest non-qualified purchase | Smallest IRA purchase | Largest purchase without home office approval |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Life Only | 40 | 90 | 0 (single life) | $10,000 (10000) | $5,000 (5000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Cash Refund | 40 | 90 | 0 (single life) | $10,000 (10000) | $5,000 (5000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain | 40 | 90 | 0 (single life) | $10,000 (10000) | $5,000 (5000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity 20-Year Certain | 40 | 85 | 0 (single life) | $10,000 (10000) | $5,000 (5000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 50% Survivor | 50 | 90 | 45 | $25,000 (25000) | $25,000 (25000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |
| Ashgrove Income Annuity Joint 100% Survivor | 50 | 90 | 45 | $25,000 (25000) | $25,000 (25000) | $2,000,000 (2000000) |

## Figures common to all six tiers

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rate lock — period the payout rate quoted at application is held while exchange or transfer funds are in transit | 60 calendar days |
| Longest period certain allowed on an IRA contract under the minimum distribution rules | 20 years |
| Accepted origins of purchase money | New money; 1035 exchange; IRA transfer; IRA rollover; annuitization of an Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity; annuitization of an Ashgrove fixed indexed annuity |

## Tier comparisons (hypothetical)

- An annuitant aged 87 last birthday on the issue date is within the age range of the Life Only, Cash Refund and 10-Year Certain tiers (40 to 90) but above the highest issue age of the 20-Year Certain tier (85).
- A couple aged 62 and 47 meets the joint tiers' figures (lowest issue age 50, younger annuitant at least 45); a couple aged 62 and 44 does not meet the younger-annuitant figure.
- A non-qualified purchase of $20,000 meets the smallest non-qualified purchase on the single-life tiers ($10,000) but not on the joint tiers ($25,000).
